inputs.label: Set maximal display precision in decimal points: 1

notes: In this calculator, mcg is the abbreviation for micrograms.

To make simple unit conversions, select the starting units with the pull-down selector on the right. Then type a starting value in the top FROM input box. To convert the value, choose the new unit in the lower right selector. The converted value will appear immediately in the TO box.

Helpful Tips Conversion factors Antithrombin III mg/dL X 10 = Antithrombin III mg/L Antithrombin III U/dL X 10 = Antithrombin III U/L Coagulation Factors U/mL X 1000 = Coagulation Factors U/L Fibrin Degradation Products mg/L X 1 = Fibrin Degradation Products mcg/mL Fibrinogen mg/dL X 0.01 = Fibrinogen g/L Plasminogen mg/dL X 10 = Plasminogen mg/L Plasminogen U/dL X 10 = Plasminogen U/L Protein C mg/dL X 10 = Protein C mg/L Protein C U/dL X 10 = Protein C U/L Protein S mg/dL X 10 = Protein S mg/L Protein S U/dL X 10 = Protein S U/L
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.
